documents.title: Video Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Video visit, on her lunch break.

Psychiatry discharged her in December - off olanzapine since October, still well. Endocrinology signed off - TSH 2.6 off levothyroxine in December. Iron done, Hgb 12.6. Implant in left arm since September, no problems with it. Still nursing morning and night, planning to wean by spring. Migraines about twice a month. Methadone 60 mg at the program, steady.

Mood good. Sleeping well. PHQ-9 2.

Exam: video only, well, relaxed, normal speech and thought.

A/P - problem list updated:
- Postpartum psychosis 11/2019, full remission -> history. If another pregnancy is ever on the table: perinatal psychiatry BEFORE conceiving (per psychiatry).
- Postpartum thyroiditis 12/2019-11/2020, recovered -> history. Yearly TSH; check early in any future pregnancy and after delivery.
- Ruptured L ectopic 8/2020 s/p L salpingectomy -> history; early ultrasound in any future pregnancy.
- Migraine without aura, OUD in sustained remission on methadone - unchanged.
Physical in the fall. COVID vaccine when her group opens up.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
34F, annual exam. First in-person physical since 2018 - a lot has happened (see problem list).

Doing well. Back on campus full time. Daughter 22 months. Weaned in March. The right breast lump went away on its own over the winter. Migraines 1-2/month, sumatriptan works. Methadone 60 mg via program, take-homes weekly now, no use. No tobacco since 2015, no alcohol. Implant in L arm, no concerns. Mood good, sleeping well.

Meds: methadone 60 mg daily (OTP), sumatriptan 50 mg prn, naloxone nasal prn, etonogestrel implant (9/2020).
NKDA.

Exam: well. Thyroid normal size, no nodules. Heart RRR, lungs clear. Breasts: symmetric, no masses either side, including R periareolar area; no nipple discharge, no axillary adenopathy. Abdomen soft, healed laparoscopic port scars. Implant palpable L medial upper arm, no redness. Skin: old antecubital scarring. Neuro normal.

A/P
- Health maintenance: Pap/HPV 9/2018 normal, next 2023. Flu shot next month. COVID series done; booster when eligible.
- Labs: CBC, CMP, lipids, TSH (yearly after postpartum thyroiditis).
- Galactocele - resolved.
- History of postpartum psychosis, postpartum thyroiditis, ectopic - as previously noted.
- Migraine, OUD in remission - stable.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: All your labs from Tuesday are normal, including the yearly thyroid check and cholesterol. See you next fall.

documents.title: Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Migraines picked up this spring - about 3-4 a month, worse around end-of-semester, short nights with a toddler who wakes early. Same type, no aura, no neuro symptoms, nothing new about them. Sumatriptan aborts each one, takes the second tab maybe once a month. Not using OTC analgesics on other days.

Doesn't want a daily medicine. Methadone 60 mg unchanged, program fine.

Exam: BP normal. Neuro: nonfocal, fundi normal.

A/P: Migraine without aura, episodic, mild uptick with sleep loss. Under the threshold for prevention, and she prefers not. Sleep, regular meals, hydration. Keep diary; if >4/month for 3 months, revisit prevention options that don't interact with methadone. Refilled sumatriptan.

documents.title: Preconception Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Preconception visit with husband present. They hope to conceive in 2025.

We went through each part of her history:
1. Postpartum psychosis (2019): the main risk. A substantial share of women with a prior episode have another after a later delivery. Psychiatry asked for a perinatal psychiatry consult before conception - referral placed today. Options there will include medication started right after delivery and a sleep plan; she wants to hear them before deciding. Husband and her mother are ready to take nights again.
2. Postpartum thyroiditis (2019-20): likely to recur. TSH early in pregnancy and again a couple of months after delivery. Last TSH 9/2024 normal.
3. Ectopic (2020), left tube removed: higher chance of another ectopic; she needs a pregnancy test and an early ultrasound as soon as she has a positive test. Remaining tube normal at surgery.
4. Methadone 60 mg: continue throughout, as last time; the program will follow her dose.
5. Migraine: acetaminophen first in pregnancy; occasional sumatriptan ok.
6. Implant (2020, extended use): OB referral for removal once psychiatry has seen her and they feel ready.
7. Prenatal vitamin with folate - restart now.

Exam: vitals normal. No exam beyond that today.

Plan: referrals to perinatal psychiatry and OB. Prenatal vitamin started. Message me with a positive test the same day.
